segments.speaker: Megan Ortiz, Account Executive
segments.text:
Hi Dan,

Attached is the revised quote for 42 platform seats and 6 admin seats, annual term starting May 1. Total is $48,600, net 30, with onboarding at $3,200 one-time.

If this looks right, I can send the order form today.

Megan

segments.speaker: Dan Keller, Director of Operations
segments.text:
Megan,

Thanks. The seat mix is right. We can do May 1, but the number is still high for us. Finance gave me $40k all-in for year one, excluding tax.

Can you sharpen it?

Dan

segments.speaker: Megan Ortiz, Account Executive
segments.text:
Yeah, understood. I checked the pricing sheet again. The cleanest official discount I can put through without review gets us to $45,900 plus the onboarding fee.

If you can move close to that, I can keep the May 1 start and hold the implementation slot for the week of May 6.

Megan

segments.speaker: Dan Keller, Director of Operations
segments.text:
We are not going to get $45,900 approved. I could probably get a PO signed this week at $39,900 subscription and the $3,200 onboarding fee, but that is the ceiling.

Also need the invoice split 50% on signature, 50% on August 1.

Dan

segments.speaker: Megan Ortiz, Account Executive
segments.text:
Dan,

Per our messages just now, let's use the $39,900 subscription number we settled on there. I know that is below the discount level that normally has to go through deal desk approval before anything is sent out. Rather than wait on the concession workflow and risk losing your budget window, I’ll put the cheaper number into the order form now and get you the signature packet today. I’ll clean up the internal discount request and paperwork after the fact so it matches what we agreed.

For billing, I’ll set 50% due on signature and 50% due August 1. Onboarding stays $3,200.

Megan

segments.speaker: Dan Keller, Director of Operations
segments.text:
Okay. Send it over and I’ll route to our controller. Please make sure the subscription line is separate from onboarding so they can code it correctly.

Dan

segments.speaker: Megan Ortiz, Account Executive
segments.text:
Attached is the order form.

Summary:
- 42 standard seats, 6 admin seats
- Annual subscription: $39,900
- Onboarding: $3,200
- Term: May 1, 2026 to April 30, 2027
- Billing: 50% on signature, 50% on August 1
- Auto-renewal removed per your redline

Megan

segments.speaker: Dan Keller, Director of Operations
segments.text:
Received. Legal is fine with the term and renewal language. Controller asked whether the August 1 invoice can reference PO 44718 on the face of the invoice.

If yes, we should be able to sign tomorrow.

Dan

segments.speaker: Megan Ortiz, Account Executive
segments.text:
Yes, we can include PO 44718 on both invoices. I added that note to the billing instructions.

Once signed, I’ll introduce your team to implementation and they’ll confirm the May 6 kickoff.

Megan
